text: I'd like you to make a watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream. I've been picturing a place like this as a little mental escape when things feel busy. The image should be square, and there should be soft green hills behind the cottage. I think that's why I keep coming back to this particular scene. Please don't include any text.
